profile.headline: Engineering at Sojern
profile.geoLocationName: Pine Brook, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary:
After getting a Compaq Presario laptop as a gift for my 13th birthday, I was hooked onto everything related to that awesome device, that I would try to use whenever I could and find excuses to shoehorn into every part of my life.

That obsession has only been stoked as I grew up and transitioned from using computer applications to creating them. The curiosity that drives me stems from the intention of solving most problems with software and keep trying until something gives (just like my coffee maker, which turned into a paper weight after my attempt at reprogramming it).

After high school I decided that computer science is my true north and completed my Bachelor’s in Computer Engineering from Mumbai, India.

Years of industry experience have been instrumental in shaping my working style and made me proficient in a production environment.

Specialties: Back-end development, Go, Python 3, Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL
Experience in: GCP, Terraform, Prometheus, Jenkins, JIRA, GraphQL, gRPC

Keywords: Backend; Back-end; Back end; API; Engineering; Development; Microservices

positions.description:
• Developed dynamic heatmap that depicts driver activity by speed based on the geolocation dataset across North America.
• Built a scalable comparison model studying driving behavior by speed, roads, location, time, etc. with dynamic visualizations.
• Technologies used: Python3, Numpy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter notebook, AWS S3.

positions.title: Technical Support Manager
positions.description:
• Co-ordinated equipment and database management for UMass Boston classrooms, events and auditorium.
• Responsible for handling the primary faculty database, fixing tickets, classroom equipment setup and troubleshooting.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed front-end and back-end features on a Java based legacy project while gaining project experience in MVC, Spring and Hibernate frameworks. Performed unit tests, integration tests, weekly client interaction, bug fixes, database mocks, report generation and software documentation.
• Designed and built a dynamic web application for event management and event organization with custom functions for visitors and admins. Deployed on company’s local servers and saw usage increase of 35% by in-house teams in 6 months.
• Technologies used: Java, JSP, Spring, Hibernate, Oracle SQL, Junit, Jenkins, Cobertura, Selenium, JIRA.

positions.title: Software Intern
positions.description:
• Developed windows and web applications using WPF and ASP.NET. Tasked with unit, integration testing and front-end development. Achieved Microsoft certification – Microsoft Technology Associate.
• Built a dynamic shopping website named eApparels which catered to men’s clothing. The website was built on C# using Visual Studio 2012 and MS SQL Server 2008. Achieved certification for Microsoft certified Professional.
• Technologies used: C#, .NET, WPF, MS SQL server 2008, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript.

positions.title: Database Management Intern
positions.description:
•	Implemented back-end unit and integration testing, while working as associate database administrator. 
•	Research and Project Implementation on Microsoft SQL Server 2008. Extensive training on higher level stored-procedure and trigger implementations in MVC architecture application.

projects.title: Power Racing Arena
projects.description:
- Arcade car racing game with mathematical concepts for children. Began as an idea for playing and learning at the same time. Made with love in Unity3D using C# and deployed on Google Play Store.
- Racing with obstacles displaying arithmetic functions. Power through walls to increase car strength. 
- Game features low poly graphics, open source object assets, user scoreboard and custom changeable vehicles.

projects.title: Instadroid - Instagram client for Android
projects.description:
- Instagram client for Android devices using Instagram developer API and JSON parsing with GSON.
- Application features user likes/dislikes, recent media roll, user logout and saved sessions.
Libraries used- Retrofit and Glide.
